name: Elżbieta Katarzyna Łukacijewska - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on women’s entrepreneurship in rural and island areas and outermost regions
part_text:
Women who run businesses in the countryside, on islands and in the EU's most remote regions face extra hurdles: little access to money, childcare, transport and internet, and farm work that often goes unpaid and unrecognised. This report is the Parliament's set of requests to the European Commission and member states. It asks them to make it easier for these women to get funding, land, training and social protection, and to include them when rural and farming policies are designed.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and member states to act, for example on funding, land access and childcare.
- **Who it affects:** Women entrepreneurs, farmers and farm spouses in rural, island and outermost regions.
- **What happens next:** The requests go to the Council and Commission; whether they become law or funding depends on them.
